title: Neon Plasma Armory Interactive Expansion Revision 3

items.name: Energy Pickup
items.collection_description: A compact cyan plasma collection burst expanding from a brilliant central point with short violet fragments and generous transparent padding.

items.name: Plasma Grenade
items.detonation_description: A compact high-energy plasma detonation that reads as the natural destructive release of the grenade's cyan core, with a tight brilliant center and short irregular energy spikes.

items.name: Portable Shield Emitter
items.field_description: One isolated broad protective cyan energy barrier arc, open at the bottom for a ground emitter, with a thin readable pixel edge, restrained violet energy seams, and a transparent-looking empty interior.
items.impact_description: One isolated shield-hit reaction keyframe: an asymmetric curved cyan energy ripple with a brilliant compact contact point and a few restrained violet fragments.

items.name: Armory Supply Crate
items.open_description: The reinforced gunmetal lid is visibly hinged open while the interior remains dark and no loose contents are shown; preserve the cyan powered latch and restrained violet status light.
items.empty_description: The reinforced gunmetal lid is fully hinged open and the empty interior cavity is clearly visible; preserve the cyan powered latch, restrained violet status light, proportions, and perspective.
